narrative.overview: The user chose a scrolling home. The selected Elegant Service List and supplied image remain in the opening viewport beneath a sticky compact Porcelain header. Below it are salon, training, airbrush, gallery, about, blog, and contact sections plus a full footer. Home contact links target #contact; separate detail pages remain. The prior single-screen home policy is superseded.
keyCharacteristics: Scrolling home with preserved opening hero
Supplied image confined to first viewport with subtle bottom fade
Cormorant Garamond display and Sofia Sans continuation body
Home service sections and contact anchor
Working navigation and official booking links
dos: Preserve the chosen first-viewport hero and image positioning.
Allow home and inner pages to scroll naturally.
Use #contact for home header contact links.
Keep sample email and preview-only form explicit.
donts: Do not restore the superseded single-screen home policy.
Do not send contact form data.
Do not invent dates or prices.
Do not alter supplied image originals.
Do not treat historical alternatives as current authority.
